migration.policy: Separate internal envelope; no mutation or migration of V1 snapshots/readers

identity.snapshotId: SHA256 of canonical full envelope excluding snapshotId
identity.asOf: Explicit valid instant shared by normalized input and V2 output; V1 result is captured at that cut by integration
identity.engine: Existing ENGINE_VERSION; no parallel canonical engine version invented
identity.parameters: C03 plus SHA256 of exact C03 values and accepted parameter-manifest hash
identity.decision_table: Existing DECISION_TABLE.version plus exact content hash
identity.sources: Accepted price/temporal/freshness contract hashes plus normalized sourceId/sourceVersion set and calendar id/version/kind/source identities

fields.v2: Complete unchanged evaluateRegime output, including all 59 evidence records, qualitative dimensions, pillars, rule, source statuses, reasons, dependency evidence and diagnostic input hash; null on calculation/source preparation failure
fields.normalizedInput: Exact JSON-safe EngineInput used for V2; null only when no accepted normalized input was available
fields.error: Explicit typed code/message for failure; no silently healthy fallback
fields.sourceStatus: Preserved operational source status; full engine source status also remains in v2
fields.captureMetadata: JSON provenance envelope supplied by integration, including pipeline capture references, source input ledger, origin and available raw/vintage identifiers
fields.replayClass: Actual frozen engine class; UNKNOWN without output
fields.comparison: V1 and V2 labels, literal equality if both exist, NON_EQUIVALENT_TAXONOMY, semanticallySame=null, v1IsTruthLabel=false
fields.observation: Bounded versioned incremental checkpoint and current observable facts, never an engine input

serialization.format: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with newline on disk
serialization.lossy_json_conversion: REJECT_NON_JSON_SNAPSHOT; undefined, nonfinite, cyclic or other non-lossless data must not silently change exact replay
serialization.hash_meaning: Local content integrity and exact identity, not source authentication

persistence.location: Absolute external runtime directory; repository root, public subtree and symlink aliases into the repository are rejected
persistence.layout: <snapshotId>.json; bounded one-snapshot writes, no historical directory walk
persistence.publish: Exclusive mode-0600 temporary file, write and fsync, atomic non-overwriting hard link, temporary cleanup
persistence.collision: Same bytes are idempotent; different existing bytes fail without overwrite
persistence.read: Size-bound read, schema/content/checkpoint identity validation, deep freeze
persistence.checkpoint_history: Caller supplies at most one previously read immutable snapshot; envelope stores its id, not nested history
persistence.storage_trust: Configured local operational filesystem; content hashes provide integrity but are not signatures or an external authentication system

replay.successful_snapshot: Validate snapshot and original versions; evaluate exact normalizedInput; compare the entire output canonically, including engineVersion, C03, regime, pillars, concordance, uncertainty, dataQuality, evidence, source statuses, reason codes and diagnostics
replay.failure_without_successful_output: NOT_REPLAYABLE_FAILURE with original recorded failure; do not manufacture a successful historical result

observability.age_unit: Observed adjacent eligible equity sessions, not calendar days
observability.duration_censoring: A run already active at an epoch boundary is left censored; its true start and time since last transition are unknown

continuity.ADJACENT: Current authoritative equity calendar names previous observation as its immediately preceding session, both outputs complete, same engine/contracts/calendar versions/replay class/evidence basis, monotonic asOf
continuity.SAME_SESSION_REOBSERVED: Same observation date and exact normalized input excluding asOf, with same complete output excluding asOf/inputHash; keep checkpoint and ages, no counter increment and regimeChanged=null
continuity.SAME_SESSION: Changed same-session input or evidence is an explicit revision and begins a censored epoch
continuity.break_behavior: No bridging, transition inference or age continuation; previous immutable epoch remains available for explicit offline aggregation

bounded_checkpoint.runs_retained: Current run and one last closed run
counters: A-B-A reversals with B duration <=1/2/3/5 eligible sessions
bounded_checkpoint.conflicting_pillars: Existing concordance LOW: opposed resolved lineage evidence; no new score or vote
bounded_checkpoint.material_volatility_candidate: Existing C03 volatility WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS episode; an observational candidate requiring subsequent adjudication, not a newly calibrated materiality threshold
bounded_checkpoint.stress_branches: Frozen C03 absolute VIX stress and joint adverse-VIX + momentum + inverted-curve predicates, with existing numeric tolerance; both may hold on one observation
bounded_checkpoint.epoch_boundary_fragments: First already-active conflict/material/stress episodes are censored fragments. Candidate counts do not establish fully observed onset or independence
bounded_checkpoint.overflow: Reject unsafe integer counters instead of silent saturation or rollover

evidence_plan.prospective_candidate_eligibility: Output replayClass R0, input mode R0, and captureMetadata.origin PROSPECTIVE; the capture/normalization boundary remains responsible for supporting that claim
evidence_plan.r2_counts: Descriptive checkpoint only; all prospective-plan contribution fields zero
evidence_plan.unverified_counts: Descriptive checkpoint only; all prospective-plan contribution fields zero
evidence_plan.adjudication: Observed transitions are candidates. No automated truth labeling or invented human adjudication. A governed later review must certify adjudicability and consolidate censored/disjoint epochs

invariants: No H1 execution or hidden hysteresis
No persistence rule, smoothing or state hold
No V2 score, probability or confidence percent
No cross-asset or PFL core additions
BTC/GLD remain contextual satellites with zero votes
No fetch or filesystem writes inside canonical classifier
No public route/export is added by snapshot module
R2 is not PIT OOS and remains R2
